title: Bystander heard screams from a compacted garbage truck; 25 firefighters rescued a trapped man alive
summary_full: In an alarming incident in San Francisco, a heroic garbage truck rescue took place after a bystander detected distressing screams. Brave firefighters worked meticulously for over two hours to hand-remove the compacted refuse, eventually freeing a conscious individual. Before 7 a.m., paramedics rushed him to the hospital after providing essential treatment to avert severe medical issues. Authorities are now looking into what led to this alarming event.
